explanation: In Deuteronomy 7 this refers to the people of Israel whom God has chosen as His special people.
Means to be set apart or dedicated for a divine purpose; in this context, the people of Israel are called holy because they are chosen by God.
This refers to other peoples and nations outside of Israel, who were often regarded as pagans.
This means partnerships or agreements between two parties, often between nations. In Deuteronomy 7 the Israelites are warned against making such alliances with other nations.
To remove completely, ruin, or eliminate. In this context God speaks of destroying the nations occupying the promised land before the Israelites arrive.
This refers to false gods, statues, or symbols representing false deities. The Israelites are instructed to destroy these when they enter the promised land.
To grant divine favor, protection, or prosperity. God promises to bless the Israelites if they obey His commands and stay away from other gods.
